name: Rating series
description: Every version that stood on one ladder at any of `points` evenly spaced edges from `since` to now (or the close), with its conservative rating and rank at each edge and null where it did not stand, and its `model_id` so a page joins a model's versions into one line (rating_series). Every edge but the last reads the hour's snapshot at or before it (ladder_snapshots, which withdraw writes hourly), so the cost is the points times the field whatever the season's length; the last edge reads the ladder as it stands. `ladder` defaults to open, `since` to the season's opening, `points` to 60 and is clamped to 2..200, each in SQL; `season` is a slug, else the live season or the latest closed.
